title: Adamski's Martian and Venusian Nordic society

tellings.quote: Adamsky says that these beings who come from both Mars and and Venus and inhabit the whole solar system, whatever, he says, "Oh, they're far more enlightened than us.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, describes the claims of George Adamski, a man in 1950s America who said he met human-looking beings from space. According to Jorjani, Adamski said these beings came from Mars and Venus, lived across the whole solar system, and were far more enlightened than us, which Jorjani raises when arguing that such beings may have shaped human religion.
